# get_tool_configuration_tool

> Get configuration requirements for a specific tool.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=get_tool_configuration_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get configuration requirements for a specific tool. This allows you to understand what 
configuration fields are needed for a tool before creating an agent that uses it.

This tool helps you gather the necessary configuration information from users to properly 
set up tool_configurations in an agent.

Returns:
- Tool type (system/custom)
- Configuration fields with details (name, label, type, options)
- Whether configuration is optional
- Tool description and input schema

Tool types:
- System tools: Built-in tools like 'send_email_tool', 'general_crud_tool', etc.
- Custom tools: User-created tools stored in the database

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tool_name` | string | yes | Name of the tool to get configuration for. |
